title: THE DEATH CARD SHOWS WHAT YOU LOST BIGGER
why: Seen on the 4K death card screenshot of 2026-10-08: the picture beside each item you lost was 24 pixels, a speck on a TV beside the 52 pixel pictures of what you bring home on an extraction (v19.99). They are 32 now, still in line with the names.
now: The death card pictures of what you lost are bigger.
